A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XI · the cattle family

Minotaurs

Five bovine monster girls: the farm cattle, the Minoan of the labyrinth, the bison, the aurochs and the water buffalo. Strong, steady and generous. They are the only family with men among them, so they can be farmed: a minotaur bull and a minotaur cow fed wheat raise a calf.

Favourite food: Wheat (a hay bale above all)

The central similarity

Strength that feeds a farm.

Minotaurs are herd animals, slow to anger and very hard to stop once angry. A minotaur cow can be milked; a herd of cows and bulls fed wheat grows on its own.

  • MilkA bucket on a grown minotaur cow gives milk (once every few minutes).
  • BullsAbout one minotaur in three is a bull. Bulls and cows breed with wheat, like cattle.
  • ChargeHurt one and she lowers her horns and charges, knocking you flying.
  • WheatThe family's favourite food. A hay bale is worth three wheat.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a minotaur builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Wheat (+1), hay bales (+3)
  • Brushing (+2)
  • Milking her gently (+1)

What costs trust

  • Hitting her (the herd remembers)
  • Taking her calf away

Devoted (60+)

She ploughs your fields and lends her strength: Strength I while she is beside you in a fight.

Mating & young

FormA single calf (cows and bulls breed with wheat). YoungCalf (half are bulls), grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her mother. Bulls have their own model (<species>_male).

1. BreedingA grown cow and bull, both fed wheat, raise a calf within a day. A player at high friendship can share a cow's bed as with any family.
2. CalvingThe calf is born beside her mother; half are bulls.
3. HerdCalves follow their mother, then the herd's lead cow.
4. GrownCalves grow up in five days.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

MilkingUse a bucket on a grown cow: milk, once every five minutes (every two and a half at high friendship).
BullsBulls are taller and heavier, with bigger horns. They never share a player's bed and defend the herd.
BreedingFeed a cow and a bull wheat and they court: a calf follows within a day, without any player in between.
ChargeHurt one and she charges: big knockback and damage. The whole herd gets angry with a bull's bellow.
PloughingA devoted minotaur tills dirt and grass around your farm into farmland as she walks.

Cattle (about 2.0 blocks)

TemperamentGentle, patient, motherly

Ecology & behaviourThe farm minotaur. Grazes, gives the best milk and dozes in the sun.

Signature: The best milkShe can be milked twice as often at high friendship, and brings milk and wheat as presents.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Tuskin: befriended, the powder snow round her friend packs into snow blocks, and the cold lets go of them
  • Skjoldram: befriended, she butts creepers away from her friend and stamps out their fuses
  • Bulls (one in three, their own model) and cows; bulls never share a player's bed
  • Milking with a bucket (twice as often at high friendship)
  • Wheat puts a cow and a bull in the mood: they raise a calf on their own (half are bulls)
  • Charging (herd-wide anger), brushing (+2)
  • Minoan guards her ground (warning bellow, then a charge)
  • Bison stampede when one is hurt
  • Aurochs cannot be knocked back
  • Water buffalo wallow in water by day
  • Devoted: ploughing next to your farmland, Strength in a fight
  • Dustbison: befriended, when her friend near her catches fire she rolls them in the dust: the fire goes out, a few seconds of Fire Resistance
  • Reedbull: befriended, she plants sugar cane beside the water near her friend
  • Mooskuh: a moss calf; the stone she rests on grows into moss, and she gives milk
  • Bronzejaw ox: led on a lead, she ploughs the grass and dirt she walks over into farmland
  • Rhiwool: a woolly rhino who charges in a straight line at her target (8 damage, knocked flying); shearable and dyeable like the sheep
  • Sheep: shears take her wool (back after she grazes), any dye colours it; vanilla sheep follow her
  • Highland and yak never freeze and walk on powder snow; the yak carries a chest of cargo (two rows) for a friend

Not yet

  • Cheese

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Only the minotaurs have males, so herds can be farmed without a player.
  • Bulls never share a player's bed.

Open questions

  • Should cheese become its own item?
